facilities.notes: NEON Domain D07 (Appalachians and Cumberland Plateau); domain support facility (Field Operations Office) in Oak Ridge, TN. Site host: Great Smoky Mountains National Park (NPS; research permits via IRMA). Colocated aquatic site: LeConte Creek (LECO). Colocated research: GRSM-Elkmont NADP, UNESCO Southern Appalachian MAB reserve, CZEN, AmeriFlux. No park superintendent or NPS research staff named on the fetched NPS management page; host leadership not recorded. No ORCID found for Bill Martin (ORCID search for Martin with NEON/Battelle affiliation returned no match).

NEON Domain D19 (Taiga); D18/D19 share the domain support facility in Fairbanks, AK. Site host: Alaska Department of Natural Resources (land manager; NEON page asks researchers to coordinate with the NEON Domain Manager before contacting DNR). Colocated research: North Slope Science Initiative, CZEN, AmeriFlux. No host-agency staff named.

NEON Domain D03 (Southeast); domain support facility in Gainesville, FL. Site host: The Jones Center at Ichauway (Robert W. Woodruff Foundation property). Colocated aquatic site: Flint River (FLNT). Colocated research: Jones Center, CZEN, AmeriFlux, NOAA USCRN. Host-center leadership (not NEON staff, so not added as NEON-site affiliations): jonesctr.org/about-us lists Kier D. Klepzig as 'Director/Entomology and Microbiology' and Jeffery B. Cannon as 'Landscape Ecology/ Deputy Director for Research'; these belong to a Jones Center facility record if one exists.

NEON Domain D06 (Prairie Peninsula); domain support facility in Manhattan, KS. Site host: Konza Prairie Biological Station (Kansas State University; land held with The Nature Conservancy). Colocated terrestrial site: Konza Prairie Agroecosystem (KONA). Colocated research: KPBS, Konza Prairie LTER, NADP, CZEN, NOAA USCRN. KPBS homepage names no director (only a burn-crew contact); Konza LTER contacts belong to the LTER facility record. ORCID 0000-0002-2030-2618 is registered as 'Rebecca Miller' (Becky is the NEON page's form); accepted because the employment record matches exactly: Battelle Field Science Manager, Manhattan KS, from 2017-01, after Kansas State University project manager 2009-2016, matching the NEON profile (KSU project manager, joined NEON Jan 2017).

NEON Domain D03 (Southeast); domain support facility in Gainesville, FL. Site host: University of Florida Foundation (Ordway-Swisher Biological Station). Colocated terrestrial site: OSBS; SUGG is also within OSBS. Host-station personnel page lists John Davis as Director and Tracey Sleek as Assistant Director of OSBS (host-station staff, not NEON; not added as NEON-site affiliations).

NEON Domain D03 (Southeast); domain support facility in Gainesville, FL. Site host: University of Florida Foundation (Ordway-Swisher Biological Station). Colocated terrestrial site: OSBS; BARC is also within OSBS. Host-station personnel page lists John Davis as Director and Tracey Sleek as Assistant Director of OSBS (host-station staff, not NEON; not added as NEON-site affiliations).

people.name: Bill Martin
people.bio: Manages NEON field science operations for Domain 07 (Appalachians and Cumberland Plateau), based in Tennessee. Earlier worked at the Pantex facility in Amarillo, Texas, first as an environmental and ecological sampling technician (1993-1997) and later, from 2007, as operations manager for its environmental remediation projects before joining NEON.

people.name: Chris Baird
people.bio: Field operations manager for NEON Domains 18 (Tundra) and 19 (Taiga), run from the Fairbanks, Alaska domain facility. Holds a B.S. from the University of British Columbia (2007) and an M.S. in biology from Queen's University (2013), and previously worked for state, federal and private research groups in the U.S. and Canada.
people.research_interests: seabird ecology; arctic ecology (prior research focus)

people.name: Guy Fausnaught
people.bio: Field operations manager for NEON Domain 03 (Southeast) in Gainesville, Florida, overseeing instrument upkeep, field sampling and lab work across three aquatic and three terrestrial sites in Florida and Georgia. Joined Battelle in 2005 on chemical-weapon demilitarization monitoring and moved to NEON in 2017; B.S. in biology, Jacksonville State University.

people.name: Becky Miller
people.bio: Field science manager for NEON Domain 06 (Prairie Peninsula) in Kansas since January 2017. Earned a B.S. in animal science at Kansas State University (2000) and spent years there as a project manager, with work centered on infectious disease in livestock and on reducing biological threats to the food-animal sector.
people.research_interests: infectious disease research in foreign and domestic livestock; mitigating bio-terrorism threats to the food animal industry
